A farm for fear itself, the beasts reared here have turned from tasty morsels to terrifying monsters after realising the deadly power of cooperation.
Every 60 seconds, one fence to the east opens up. After 15 minutes, fences stop opening up. The
Merchant appears at the beginning of the stage, but will run far to the east once the timer starts.
The game and the stage's enemies speed up significantly as time increases.
At the beginning of the stage, enemy
Chickenfantries run through the area that should be killed to start the timer.
If the player does not kill any Chickenfantries for one minute, a special event with

Gaea will occur. The screen will gradually start to zoom in, the music stops, and the stage's background disappears and become a solid rainbow color, all before the Avatar of Gaea slowly approaches the player from the bottom of the screen. When it is close to the player, the background suddenly turns dark, Gaea disappears, and a strange chiming sound plays before its eyes briefly flash onto the screen for a moment before the run automatically ends. This counts as completing the stage and unlocks the
. This event will only occur once.

The name of this stage was intended to be a pun on the word "

Before the player kills the first Chickenfantry, the stage's theme, "Martes de poncle", is played in slow motion. After the first Chickenfantry is killed, it will be played in normal speed. After the first minute, it will be played at a higher speed.
The mechanic where the player must kill a
Chickenfantry before the level's timer starts serves as a possible reference to a recurring mechanic in
series, where if the player harms a
for long enough, it will cause a swarm of Cuccos to fly in and attack the player.
